source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Once per turn, a single model in your army that has this ability may use it during the Shooting phase of your opponent's turn, when another ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit of yours is destroyed within 6" of that model. After the attacking unit finishes all its attacks, that model may shoot as if in your own Shooting phase, but it may target only that attacking unit, and only when that unit is an eligible target.

limit.scope: one model with this ability in your army

ability.timing: after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks

effect.shoot: as if it were your Shooting phase
effect.targetRestriction: only the attacking enemy unit, provided it is an eligible target

cardPrintsOtherText.name: Storm of Vengeance (Once per turn, per unit)
